title: VoiceNodeBlacklist
description: Persistent operator exclusion at /discordy/voice/blacklist/nodes/<node_id> or /discordy/voice/blacklist/regions/<region>. Key presence excludes new allocations regardless of probe success, including malformed values. Probers must never modify or delete it. Clearing the exact key removes only the manual exclusion; required health, draining and identity checks still apply. Existing calls continue.
